terms.title: Delivery Area
terms.body: Free delivery to your doorstep is available here! Subject to select building partners within Century City, Makati. Delivery times may differ for buildings further away; estimates will be communicated via text on WhatsApp or Viber.

terms.title: Delivery
terms.body: The delivery window begins once the pizza leaves the oven and applies only to orders within the specified free delivery area. Delivery times may vary due to order volume, weather, building access, or elevator wait times.

terms.title: Bundle Availability
terms.body: Promo bundles (Double XL Slices, Date Night, Office Party Pack, Build-a-box) are available while stocks last and may be discontinued or modified without prior notice.

terms.title: Savings Disclaimer
terms.body: Advertised savings (₱79, ₱268, ₱198) are calculated based on the total value of items if purchased individually at regular menu price, compared to the bundle price.

terms.title: Flavor Substitutions
terms.body: "Any flavor" selections are subject to daily availability. City Slice reserves the right to substitute a comparable flavor if a specific option is unavailable.

terms.title: Date Night Bundle Inclusions
terms.body: Dessert and Citro Lemonade choices are limited to the selections on-hand. Please inquire for more details.

terms.title: Payment
terms.body: Orders must be paid in full before preparation of order commences. We accept GCash, Bank Transfer, and COD for this initiative.

terms.title: No App, No Driver, No Delivery Fee
terms.body: This applies to orders within the specified free delivery zone only, ordered via direct call/text/DM as indicated in official City Slice channels.

terms.title: Order Cutoff
terms.body: Orders are subject to City Slice Pizza Lounge's daily operating hours. Orders placed after cutoff time will be processed the next business day.

terms.title: Right to Amend
terms.body: City Slice Pizza Lounge reserves the right to amend these terms, prices, and promo inclusions at any time without prior notice.

terms.title: Validity
terms.body: This promo is valid for a limited time only, as indicated in official City Slice announcements.

deliveryProgram.footnote: This initiative is currently available to select building partners within Century City, Makati. Any additional terms, conditions, or requirements specific to a particular building will be indicated below and shall be considered part of these Terms & Conditions. Participating buildings are subject to change, and this list may be expanded to include additional locations as they come on board.
